authorization.quote: Adopt practical contract + approve isolated stages 1–5
authorization.scope: Isolated local candidate, disposable databases and termination only of retained own test client/server processes

invariant: At backend authorization A, exact current grant, owner, status, original revision and original fixed deadline must match. DB UTC time A must be before the fixed deadline. Every protected ownership/title/heartbeat transition shares the issue row_lock conflict mechanism. Already-authorized SQL persistence may complete after the original deadline.
clock: One backend UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) authorization sample per transaction; equality at original deadline refuses
durability_scope: Client-process and local database-server crash/restart recovery only
history_ordering: SQL COMMIT precedes any separate Dolt HEAD commit. No DOLT_ADD or DOLT_COMMIT inside the open data transaction.
receipt_authority: Exact backend operation record stored with title/revision effect in one SQL transaction. CM history cannot substitute for it.
local_tables: Grant, grant history, operation and associated namespace/token identity tables are dolt_ignored and local-only. Not replicated or merge-qualified.
recovery: Read the original operation binding in a fresh process. Missing or ambiguous outcome remains UNKNOWN. Never replay uncertain mutation, refresh identity or extend original deadline.
boundary: Protected permanent-issue adapter and skill APIs only. Not arbitrary raw bd/SQL writers, DB admin modification, wisps, multi-replica leases or merge enforcement. Unsupported protected routes refuse before mutation.
strict_contract_history: Prior strict expiry-before-recoverability records remain unchanged and unsatisfied; this explicit decision changes that requirement for this separately labelled practical capability.

stages.name: Small backend fence
stages.gate: Synchronized real old-owner transaction versus committed newer grant: zero stale title/revision/receipt; current-owner success control

stages.name: Protected ownership transitions
stages.gate: Claim, reassignment, release/reclaim and guarded heartbeat preserve grant generations; ABA/expired/missing/foreign/unsupported routes refuse

stages.name: Public skill and journal integration
stages.gate: Atomic intent winner only; backend op-id readback, immutable binding, no caller-created success or direct protected bypass

stages.name: Real interruption recovery
stages.gate: Outstanding native client kill and separate server crash/restart; fresh-process readback and repeated recovery make no additional writes

stages.name: Exact pair verification and packaging
stages.gate: Source and clean extracted-package suites, scoped adversarial review, paired digest/manifests/ZIPs/verification report; old releases retained
